Canonical original-source intake is a separate task. This package does not append raw/manual/control records, change source roles in the corpus, or promote legal currentness or coverage.

Original source acquisition and review times, absolute paths and prior statuses remain unchanged as historical receipt text. Portable verification uses local copied bytes and the existing verifier read-only modes; it does not access original paths, Git or network.
